newsitem.title: ITALY: Credito ups Telecom Italia profit estimate.
newsitem.headline: Credito ups Telecom Italia profit estimate.

text.p: Italian broker Credito Italiano said it had increased its profit estimates for 1997 and 1998 for Telecom Italia in a research update note, while it gave an estimate for its share price after the the STET merger.

Credito analyst Claudia Vignati raised her net profit forecast for the newly-merger SuperTelecom (Telecom Italia-STET) to 2.685 trillion lire from 2.100 trillion lire for 1997, and to 3.166 trillion lire from 2.350 trillion lire for 1998.
Telecom Italia has already announced net profits in 1996 of 2.119 trillion lire on net sales of 29.376 trillion lire.
Her forecasts is for a price earning ratio for the merged group of 18.2 for 1997 and 16.4 for 1998.
Vignati put the profits upgrade down to the reduction of costs and the effect of recent changes to tariff levels.
She put the target share price for the merger group at 8,000/8,500 lire per share.
STET is due to be merged with Telecom Italia later this year ahead of the privatisation of the merger group which is hoped to be launched by October.
At 1440 GMT, Telecom Italia shares were up 0.99 percent at 4,164 lire and STET 1.08 percent higher at 7,300.
